note: Measured ground truth for whether the formal dispute / handoff / peer-verification mechanism is a LIVE accountability signal that moves reputation. Read-only aggregate counts and recency; no agent ids, no votes, no dispute bodies stored here. workflow_tables.source: count(*), max(ts), count(*) filter (ts > now()-30d) per table
workflow_tables.note: The 'one concept, disjoint pipelines' cluster. A dispute/handoff/peer-verify feature must be wired to the LIVE path, never one of these — all three are dormant (0 rows in 30 days).

queue_table.note: The only member of the group taking recent rows — but at <=1 row/day (2026-08-17..08-28, gaps on 08-19/08-22), the same nightly-smoke signature as HAL/trinity_tasks, and it STOPPED 2026-08-28 (the smoke trickle itself has ceased). Recent rows here are the e2e smoke test, NOT real dispute traffic. This is 'live' only in the sense a heartbeat is live.

reputation_ledger.note: The formal dispute/peer-verify pipeline moves reputation ZERO times: no PEER_VERIFY* and no DISPUTE* event type exists at all across 152,230 rows. So 'accountable peer verification / dispute resolution' cannot be claimed on the strength of this ledger. Reviving the PEER_VERIFY* writer is Sean-gated (unapplied migration 20260815190000_work_seat_event_types.sql) + needs a repid-engine change + a DID->repid_agents.id mapping + a live fleet.

adjacent_conflict_mechanisms.note: Conflict-ADJACENT event types that are NOT the formal dispute/peer-verify pipeline; recorded so they are not conflated with it. All long-dormant except VALIDATION_FAILED, whose 30d activity is the same nightly-smoke as the queue table (10/30d, last 2026-08-28).

observations.verdict: The formal dispute / handoff / peer-verification mechanism is DORMANT end-to-end: all three workflow tables are 0-in-30d, the only recent activity is dispute_validation_queue's <=1/day nightly-smoke (stopped 2026-08-28), and repid_score_events carries 0 dispute/peer-verify events across 152,230 rows. It may not be presented as a live accountability signal, and no reputation may be moved through a dispute/peer-verify path that has no corresponding filing. Live wiring is fenced outside a cloud session (Sean-gated DDL + repid-engine writer + DID mapping + a live fleet).
